name: Lady Lucky Gun

features.name: Expanding wilds
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 expand to cover the reel.

features.name: Wild respins
features.description: Each wild triggers a respin, up to three in a row.

review:
Lady Lucky Gun is a 20-line classic built around expanding wilds and respins. Every wild that lands on reels 2 to 4 expands to cover its whole reel, and you win if the expanded wild forms a winning combination.

Each wild also triggers a respin, and landing another wild during the respin awards another, up to three in a row. BGaming rates it medium volatility with a 1,000x maximum and a 96.13% RTP. It's mechanically the same as Miss Cherry Fruits, with a western gunslinger theme. Expect frequent, modest results.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
